attributes.name: payload
attributes.description: Decoded sid_demo TLV uplink (see decoders/sidewalk-iks4a1-tlv.py). Fields populate from on-board sensors on each action notification.

childs.name: id
childs.description: sid_demo msg_desc decoded as "opc-cmd_class-cmd_id". 2-0-0 = capability frame, 2-0-1 = action frame. (Currently both arrive as 2-0-0 while the firmware msg_desc=0x40 workaround is in place; flips to 2-0-1 once the fixed decoder is live in /IOTCONNECT.)

childs.name: Sequence
childs.description: Uplink sequence counter from the firmware (tag 0x21). Wraps at 256.

childs.name: Sinewave
childs.description: Reserved sid_demo template field, always 0 for this firmware. Kept for /IOTCONNECT dashboard compatibility.

childs.name: version
childs.description: IKS4A1 firmware payload schema version (tag 0x20). Bumped when the TLV wire format changes incompatibly.

childs.name: payload_size
childs.description: Total uplink size in bytes (msg_desc + TLV stream). ~14 bytes for capability frames, ~61 bytes for action frames with all sensors present.

childs.name: sensor_data
childs.description: Whole-degree STTS22H temperature from sid_demo tag 0x06. Same physical value as temp_stts22h_c but rounded to int, kept for sid_demo-decoder compatibility.

childs.name: Temperature
childs.description: Whole-degree STTS22H temperature as a decimal (same value as sensor_data). Surfaced for the standard /IOTCONNECT Temperature widget.

childs.name: gps_time
childs.description: GPS time at uplink (tag 0x07), seconds since the Sidewalk GPS epoch. Set from sid_get_time(SID_GET_GPS_TIME). 0 if the device has not yet time-synced.

childs.name: link_type
childs.description: Sidewalk link the uplink traversed (tag 0x0C). Always "BLE" for the sid_ble app.

childs.name: acc_x_g
childs.description: LSM6DSV16X X-axis acceleration in g (tag 0x22, mg / 1000). +1 g on the +X axis when the board is sitting flat with the +X edge down.

childs.name: acc_y_g
childs.description: LSM6DSV16X Y-axis acceleration in g (tag 0x22).

childs.name: acc_z_g
childs.description: LSM6DSV16X Z-axis acceleration in g (tag 0x22). ~+1 g when the board is face-up flat on a desk.

childs.name: gyr_x_dps
childs.description: LSM6DSV16X X-axis angular rate (tag 0x23, dps*10 on the wire). Near-zero when the board is still.

childs.name: gyr_y_dps
childs.description: LSM6DSV16X Y-axis angular rate (tag 0x23).

childs.name: gyr_z_dps
childs.description: LSM6DSV16X Z-axis angular rate (tag 0x23).

childs.name: temp_stts22h_c
childs.description: High-resolution STTS22H temperature (tag 0x24, 0.01 C resolution). The IKS4A1's dedicated temperature die - most accurate temp on the board.

childs.name: temp_sht40_c
childs.description: SHT40AD1B temperature (tag 0x25, 0.01 C resolution). Co-located with the humidity sensor; compare against STTS22H for sanity.

childs.name: humidity_sht40_pct
childs.description: SHT40AD1B relative humidity (tag 0x26, 0.01 %RH resolution).

childs.name: pressure_hpa
childs.description: LPS22DF barometric pressure (tag 0x27, 0.01 hPa resolution). Typical sea-level value ~1013 hPa; drops with altitude.

childs.name: orientation
childs.description: LSM6DSV16X native 6D engine output (tag 0x28). One of: face_up / face_down / portrait_up / portrait_down / landscape_left / landscape_right / unknown. Flip the board to change it.

childs.name: qvar
childs.description: LIS2DUXS12 Qvar raw count (tag 0x29, signed int16). Capacitive variation measured on the IKS4A1 edge pads. Near-zero baseline; swings hundreds-to-thousands when a finger touches a pad.

attributes.name: decoder_name
attributes.description: Name of the /IOTCONNECT decoder that produced this record. Should always be "sidewalk-iks4a1-tlv" for this template.

properties.description: WBA55 + X-NUCLEO-IKS4A1 sensor uplink over Sidewalk BLE. Surfaces 6-axis IMU, environmental sensors, 6D orientation, and Qvar capacitive sensing via a sid_demo-style TLV payload. See examples/sidewalk-iks4a1-wba55 in the repo.
